title: Speaker audio segment catalog
description: Portable speaker segment query/export result. Source intervals and attribution revisions remain tied to immutable admitted media, across the whole workspace library.

schema_version.description: Version of this portable document contract.

workspace_id.description: Workspace owning every segment and referenced catalog identity.

catalog_revision.description: Catalog revision observed by this result.

generated_at.description: UTC instant when this result was generated.

anyOf.description: Catalog speaker requested by this query.

speaker_filter.description: Requested speaker identity, or null for an unfiltered segment result.

segments.description: Ordered source-linked segment records; an empty query result is valid.

next_cursor.description: Pagination continuation token, or null when complete.

extensions.description: Namespaced result metadata for custom segment adapters.

source.description: Immutable original audio/video source and selected audio channels; no storage path or transient URL is carried here.

media_entry_id.description: Library item owning this source relationship.

source_asset_id.description: Immutable media asset defining the original media clock.

allOf.description: Byte identity of the admitted original media artifact.

source_artifact.description: Byte identity of the admitted original media artifact.

stream_id.description: Catalog identity of the original selected audio stream.

stream_index.description: Original container audio-stream index captured during admission.

channels.description: Zero-based original channel indices used for this segment.

channel_policy.description: Declared selection or mixing policy, such as preserve or mono-mix.

interval.description: Half-open source interval in original-clock microseconds; application validation enforces end_us greater than start_us and source-duration bounds.

extensions.description: Namespaced adapter-specific source facts without paths or credentials.

attribution.description: Frozen attribution observation distinguishing a catalog speaker from a run-local acoustic voice.

attribution_id.description: Stable identity of this attribution observation stream.

revision.description: Exact immutable attribution revision used by this segment or dataset.

anyOf.description: Catalog speaker assigned by this observation.

speaker_id.description: Assigned catalog speaker UUID, or null for an unresolved voice.

anyOf.description: Exact speaker identity revision supporting this assignment.

speaker_identity_revision.description: Speaker identity revision, or null when the speaker is unresolved.

basis.description: Declared assignment basis, for example user, acoustic-comparison, reasoning or imported; custom adapter bases remain representable.

method.description: Attribution method or adapter identity; does not imply independently measured accuracy.

value.description: Reported confidence value in the declared scale.

scale.description: Scale or interpretation declared by the producing method.

method_version.description: Version of the method producing the diagnostic.

confidence.description: Optional method-qualified confidence diagnostic, or null when absent.

extensions.description: Namespaced attribution details; predictions and corrections remain distinguishable.

speaker_id.description: Match an unresolved attribution so its identity revision also remains null.

speaker_identity_revision.description: An unresolved speaker has no catalog identity revision.
A resolved assignment records a positive identity revision.

diagnostic.description: A nonsecret method-qualified processing or selection finding.

message.description: Human-readable explanation without credentials or storage paths.

method.description: Method or adapter that produced this finding.

details.description: Adapter-specific structured diagnostic measurements; must not contain secrets or local storage locations.

transcript.description: Exact selected transcript/cue evidence required by a segment or training member.

transcript_revision.description: Revision sequence of the selected transcript.

cue_ids.description: Cueson cue identifiers scoped to the transcript revision.

alignment_artifact.description: Optional alignment receipt preserving source-clock correlation.

preparedAudio.description: Materialized audio and its reproducible mapping back to the original source.

allOf.description: Immutable mapping from prepared audio intervals to original-source intervals.

time_map_artifact.description: Immutable mapping from prepared audio intervals to original-source intervals.

allOf.description: Immutable receipt naming exact transforms, effective options and tool versions.

transform_artifact.description: Immutable receipt naming exact transforms, effective options and tool versions.

sample_rate_hz.description: Prepared audio sample rate in hertz.

channel_count.description: Number of channels in the prepared audio.

duration_us.description: Prepared audio duration in integer microseconds.

segment.description: One immutable boundary revision of a speaker audio segment, including its selected attribution at the exported catalog revision.

segment_id.description: Stable identity retained when a segment boundary receives a new revision.

source.description: Original byte, stream, channel and interval provenance.

processing_run_id.description: Diarization or segmentation run that produced these intervals.

voice_id.description: Acoustic voice identity scoped to the producing processing run.

attribution.description: Exact selected attribution observation and speaker identity revision.

prepared_audio.description: Optional existing extracted audio artifact and source map.

diagnostics.description: Technical quality and overlap findings; no mandatory human approval is implied.
